title: Abandoned daily-pick worker still writes daily_picks.json
rule: Do not patch pick_scheduler or daily_pick_engine until an explicit GO.
finding: pick_scheduler._tick bumps _work_generation, runs get_or_create_today_pick on a one-thread pool, and on FuturesTimeoutError bumps the generation again and calls pool.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True). cancel_futures does not stop the thread already inside get_or_create_today_pick. The generation compare runs only after that call returns, and it only drops the return value. Before that compare, get_or_create_today_pick calls _save(records).

code.unlocked_save: internal/council/daily_pick_engine.py:43-49 _save uses a fixed .tmp path and os.replace with no flock. Called at line 284. Path is data/daily_picks.json.
code.prediction_side_effect: internal/council/daily_pick_engine.py:286-299 then calls record_pick_prediction, which appends through predictions_store.append_prediction under locked_predictions_file.

predictions_lock: internal/learning/predictions_store.py:35-59 locked_predictions_file is fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) with a 5s timeout. save_predictions and append_prediction use it. resolver._save_json and pump_lead_recover.recover_overdue_pump_leads still replace predictions.json without that lock. Those writers are outside this ticket.
